build_adaptive_softmax: build an AdaptiveSoftmax module with a given vocab size, input dim, cutoff list, and dropout rate
create_tied_linear: create a TiedLinear layer that shares weights with an embedding matrix and optionally transposes them
create_tied_head_module: create a TiedHeadModule that projects inputs using tied embedding weights and a separate class projection
run_adapt_target: run adapt_target on target tensors to remap vocabulary indices for efficient adaptive softmax computation
get_log_prob: get log probabilities for all vocabulary words from hidden vectors using the AdaptiveSoftmax module
